- Removed the skill card documentation file (skill-card.md).

Major expansion and enhancement of Gmail toolset.

- Expanded from 32 to 61 tools, with feature-rich coverage: 8 auth, 4 base Gmail, 49 extra Gmail tools.
- Added advanced draft handling: forking, threading preservation, loss detection, and detailed diffing between draft versions.
- Introduced new settings commands: manage vacation responder, filters, and send-as aliases.
- Improved attachment handling: fetch by index or legacy ID, with option to deliver inline or upload to Drive.
- Broadened bulk, label, and message tools; new options for searching, importing, and nuanced replies.
- Switched documentation from skill-card.md to comprehensive, detailed SKILL.md and supporting docs (README, CHANGELOG, LICENSE).
